spec.description: HTTP probes from Alloy's blackbox exporter.

One row per target and prober.
- Duration and DNS are 5 min averages.
- The uptime columns cover fixed windows, whatever the dashboard range.
- A blank cell is a metric that does not apply: no TLS on plain HTTP, no expiry on a `cert="external"` target.

spec.expr: max by (probe_key, instance, host, probe) (label_join(probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}, "probe_key", "|", "instance", "host", "probe"))
max by (probe_key) (label_join(probe_http_status_code{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}, "probe_key", "|", "instance", "host", "probe"))

100 * avg by (probe_key) (label_join(avg_over_time(probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[24h]), "probe_key", "|", "instance", "host", "probe") and on (instance, host, probe) probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

100 * avg by (probe_key) (label_join(avg_over_time(probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[7d]), "probe_key", "|", "instance", "host", "probe") and on (instance, host, probe) probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

100 * avg by (probe_key) (label_join(avg_over_time(probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[30d]), "probe_key", "|", "instance", "host", "probe") and on (instance, host, probe) probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})
max by (probe_key, version) (label_join(probe_tls_version_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}, "probe_key", "|", "instance", "host", "probe"))
min by (probe_key) ((label_join(probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", cert!="external"}, "probe_key", "|", "instance", "host", "probe") - time()) / 86400)
max by (probe_key) (label_join(avg_over_time(probe_duration_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]), "probe_key", "|", "instance", "host", "probe"))
max by (probe_key) (label_join(avg_over_time(probe_dns_lookup_time_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m]), "probe_key", "|", "instance", "host", "probe"))

spec.title: Probe duration
spec.description: Whole probe, including DNS, connect and TLS, for successful direct probes. Failures and their timeouts are on the Timeline tab.

spec.title: DNS lookup duration
spec.description: Successful direct probes. DNS time also counts towards probe duration.
Share of probe time per phase, averaged over the range for successful probes; a target probed from several hosts is averaged across probers. Hover a bar for the seconds.

spec.title: Proxy check duration
spec.description: Whole probe for targets with a `probe` label, such as checks through a proxy; successful probes only.

spec.title: $instance
spec.description: Share of probe time per phase for successful probes, averaged within each bucket. Where a target is probed from several hosts, the phases are averaged across probers.
Probes with a failure in the range, most failures first.

spec.expr:
sum by (instance, host, probe) (count_over_time(probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval) - sum_over_time(probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval))
* on (instance, host, probe) group_left (_sort)
count_values by (instance, host, probe) ("_sort", 1e6 - (sum by (instance, host, probe) (count_over_time(probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end()) - sum_over_time(probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0))

spec.title: Failing
spec.description: Failing probes, counted per prober rather than per target.

spec.expr: count(probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} == 0) or vector(0)

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Mean success across every probe; a target probed from several hosts counts once per prober.

spec.expr: 100 * avg(probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

spec.title: Avg duration
spec.description: Whole probe, including DNS, connect and TLS, for successful direct probes only.

spec.title: Targets probed
spec.description:
Probe targets currently reporting, counted once per prober.
- A step down is a target leaving the probe config or a prober that stopped scraping.

spec.expr: count(probe_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

spec.title: Avg DNS lookup
spec.description: Successful direct probes only. DNS time also counts towards probe duration.

spec.title: Nearest cert expiry
spec.description: Days until the earliest certificate expiry; targets labelled `cert="external"`, whose certificates someone else renews, are excluded.

spec.expr: min((probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", cert!="external"} - time()) / 86400)

spec.title: Blackbox
